rules.label: Require import.meta.dirname/filename over __dirname/__filename
rules.hint: ESM repos only. Its fix breaks CommonJS files.

rules.label: Ban console.log/debug/trace
rules.hint: Skip for CLI tools that print with console.log.

rules.label: Ban import cycles
rules.hint: Slower: walks the whole module graph.

rules.label: Ban imports missing from the nearest package.json
rules.hint: False alarms in monorepos that keep shared deps in the root package.json.

rules.label: Ban barrel files (index files that only re-export)
rules.hint: For apps. Libraries need an index that re-exports.

rules.label: Ban `export * from`
rules.hint: For apps. Libraries need an index that re-exports.

rules.label: Ban await inside loops
rules.hint: False alarms on loops that must run in order, such as pagination.

rules.label: Ban undeclared variables
rules.hint: For JavaScript-only repos. In TypeScript, tsc covers this and ambient globals cause false alarms.

rules.label: Require kebab-case file names
rules.hint: Existing repos may need many renames.

rules.label: Ban default exports
rules.hint: Not for frameworks that need default exports (Next.js pages, Remix routes, configs).

rules.label: Ban TypeScript enums
rules.hint: For Node type stripping and erasableSyntaxOnly.

rules.label: Ban variable shadowing
rules.hint: Strict; flags common patterns such as an inner `data`.

rules.label: Ban unhandled promises (nursery, type-aware)
rules.hint: Nursery rules: run `biome migrate --write` after each Biome upgrade, or the config stops loading once a rule is promoted.

rules.label: Ban promises where a value is expected (nursery, type-aware)
rules.hint: Nursery rules: run `biome migrate --write` after each Biome upgrade, or the config stops loading once a rule is promoted.

rules.label: Require switch cases for every union member (nursery, type-aware)
rules.hint: Nursery rules: run `biome migrate --write` after each Biome upgrade, or the config stops loading once a rule is promoted.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban page.waitForTimeout()
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban page.waitForNavigation()
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban "networkidle" waits
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban page.pause()
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban { force: true } on actions
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban page.waitForSelector()
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban element handles ($, $$)
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban $eval and $$eval
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

rules.label: Playwright: Ban await on sync Playwright calls
rules.hint: For Playwright repos. Fires on Puppeteer code, which has the same method names.

plugins.label: Prefer `const f = () =>` over `function f()`
plugins.hint: Skips generators and functions that use `this`. Arrow functions are not hoisted.

plugins.label: Ban `as` type assertions (allows `as const`)
plugins.hint: Strict TypeScript: narrow with checks instead.

plugins.label: Ban `as unknown as T`
plugins.hint: Catches the usual escape hatch around type errors.

plugins.label: Ban JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))
plugins.hint: Use structuredClone(x): faster and keeps Dates, Maps, and Sets.

plugins.label: Ban synchronous fs calls (readFileSync and others)
plugins.hint: Blocks the event loop. Skip for CLI tools and build scripts.

plugins.label: Ban process.exit()
plugins.hint: Set process.exitCode instead, so pending output and cleanup can finish.

plugins.label: Ban Array#reduce
plugins.hint: Use a for...of loop for readability.

plugins.label: Prefer `switch` over `if`/`else if` chains on one value
plugins.hint: Flags chains that compare one expression with `===` in two or more branches. Consecutive separate `if` statements are not detected.

guards.label: Fail lint on suppression comments
guards.hint: biome-ignore, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, eslint-disable. Biome plugins cannot see comments, so this is a script.
